name: Syria
famous_for: Damascus (one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities on Earth), Roman ruins of Palmyra, and Umayyad Mosque.
tourists: Approx. 1.2M visitors (heritage restoration underway); famous for Umayyad Mosque, Crac des Chevaliers crusader castle, and Aleppo Citadel.
must_know: Damascus has been continuously inhabited for over 11,000 years and is mentioned repeatedly across the earliest recorded histories.
fun_fact: Aleppo soap, made of olive oil and laurel berry oil, has been crafted using unchanged artisanal formulas for thousands of years.
